messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Garage estimates misfiled as correspondence",
 "problem_statement": "Handlers are forced to manually recategorize garage estimates that the system incorrectly files as correspondence. This manual correction causes delays and risks overlooking critical evidence during claims processing.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "Every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it — and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely.",
   "route": "account_management",
   "date": "2026-09-11T14:49:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it. The incorrect file type assignment is causing real delays and oversight risks.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we’ve got some handlers still manually moving garage estimates out of correspondence, and it’s causing delays.",
   "route": "account_management",
   "date": "2026-09-11T14:49:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Handlers are spending too much time fixing the incorrect file type assignments — we need a better way to classify garage estimates so we don’t miss critical evidence during claims processing.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-18T08:15:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "garage estimates keep landing in Correspondence, and our handlers have to manually move them, which risks missing critical evidence.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-11T12:56:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "handlers are wasting time fixing incorrect file type assignments, and it’s impacting claim accuracy.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "our team keeps getting locked out with ‘Keelwater is down’ messages — but it’s actually our customer network failure... when we upload garage estimates, they land under Correspondence... the Claims Tasks panel moved without warning",
   "route": "onboarding",
   "date": "2026-09-10T09:41:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "when we upload garage estimates, they’re landing in the wrong document category—like under Correspondence—and we’re having to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks.",
   "route": "onboarding",
   "date": "2026-10-06T14:24:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it, which delays claims resolution.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-18T08:15:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "uploaded documents sometimes end up misfiled — garage estimates get tagged as correspondence, and handlers have to move them manually, which risks missing critical evidence.",
   "route": "onboarding",
   "date": "2026-10-12T08:59:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that Keelwater's system misclassifies garage estimates as correspondence, forcing manual recategorization. Multiple quotes across support, account_management, and onboarding routes consistently describe the same product behavior (wrong document category assignment) causing delays and missed evidence. One quote (onboarding, 2026-09-10) mixes in an unrelated network outage attributed to the customer's own IT, but the garage estimate misfiling portion is clearly a product classification issue a squad could address. No pricing, contract, staffing, or help-article issues dominate; the core signal is a product defect.", "verdict": "pass"}
